name: SEP → ACP
rules: Preserve supported ACP target patterns and compatibility aliases.
Check legacy behavior against current ACP; do not impose broad signal, DI, or template modernization.
The baseline predates the ACP root replacement; analyze all first-parent source events after it.

Compare deploy variables and stage conditions as behaviors even when the target pipeline file is a separate ACP pipeline. A different trigger branch does not show that a source deploy gate has no target impact.

mappings.note: ACP release pipeline is separate from the L1 monorepo pipeline; still compare deploy variables and stage conditions.
